cohort: Pregnant women at Wuhan University Renmin Hospital, Hubei Province, China, from 2011 to 2019
finding: While GDM was associated with an increased risk of a few adverse maternal-perinatal outcomes, HDP was associated with a higher risk of several adverse maternal-perinatal outcomes in both singleton and twin pregnancies compared to non-GDM and non-HDP.
mod_finding: Twin pregnancies complicated with GDM and HDP showed higher odds of C-section, preterm birth, low birth weight, and low Apgar score compared with singleton pregnancies complicated with GDM and HDP.
